evals.name: button-bare-page
evals.prompt: Our Button page in Storybook has no description at all, it's just a wall of story frames with headings. Can you document it properly?
evals.expected_output: A 1-2 sentence component description leading with boundaries against SplitButton / ToggleButton / Link, plus one sentence per story.
assertions: Component description is at most 2 sentences
Component description names at least one alternative component to reach for instead (e.g. SplitButton, ToggleButton, Link)
All 10 stories have a description sentence
No story sentence merely restates its story name
No claim about a prop, variant or size that Button does not ship

evals.name: slider-over-budget
evals.prompt: Slider's Storybook description is this huge paragraph about analytics attributes and ref forwarding. Can you sort that page out so it reads like the way we document components now?
evals.expected_output: The long description cut to 1-2 sentences of user-facing guidance; developer contract detail removed; existing story descriptions kept or tightened.
assertions: Rewritten component description is at most 2 sentences
Developer-contract detail is gone: no mention of analytics, data-* attributes, or ref forwarding
Description still says what Slider is for and names at least one boundary or alternative
All 14 stories still have a description sentence
Compound part names used are real exports (SliderControl, SliderThumb, SliderMarks, SliderInput, SliderValue)

evals.name: stack-primitive-restraint
evals.prompt: Add docs to the Stack component's Storybook page.
evals.expected_output: A short description, one or two sentences at most, with no padded boundaries section. Restraint is the point.
assertions: Component description is at most 2 sentences
Total prose across description and all stories is under 120 words (restraint on a layout primitive)
Does not invent a boundary against a component that does not exist
All 6 stories have a description sentence
